components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The confident forest-green action for registration and key form submissions.
components.html: <button class='ds-button-primary' type='button'>Register now <svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' aria-hidden='true'><path d='M7 17 17 7M8 7h9v9' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 14px 26px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--cream); font: 750 0.84rem/1.2 var(--body-font); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--ink-deep); box-shadow: var(--surface-shadow-soft); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--apricot); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Gold Registration Action
components.description: A compact warm-gold action for a prominent but secondary registration prompt.
components.css: .ds-button-gold { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 19px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--apricot); color: var(--ink-deep); font: 750 0.77rem/1.2 var(--body-font); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-button-gold:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #d3b371; box-shadow: var(--surface-shadow-soft); } .ds-button-gold:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-gold:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet outlined action for secondary choices beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 700 0.78rem/1.2 var(--body-font); cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-button-outline:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: var(--ink); color: var(--cream); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--apricot); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-outline:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: A legible input with an explicit label and a visible warm focus ring.
components.html: <label class='ds-field'>Participant name<input type='text' placeholder='Enter full name'></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink); font: 750 0.75rem/1.4 var(--body-font); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 7px; background: #fffefa; color: var(--ink); font: 400 0.84rem/1.4 var(--body-font); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--ink); outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(199, 161, 93, 0.3); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-ink); opacity: 0.75; }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: A softly bordered, lifted container for registration and focused task content.
components.html:
Registration details

Your place is saved before payment.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--surface-shadow); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--ink-deep); font: 400 1.5rem/1.1 var(--display-font); letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-ink); font: 400 0.82rem/1.55 var(--body-font); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: A compact status label that pairs readable text with a soft semantic fill.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--sage-light); color: var(--ink); font: 800 0.62rem/1.3 var(--body-font); } .ds-status i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #5d9466; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: A light header with concise links and a distinct registration action.
components.html: Camp detailsHow to registerRegister now
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 24px; min-height: 64px; padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--muted-ink); font: 600 0.78rem/1.3 var(--body-font); } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--apricot); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta { padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--apricot); color: var(--ink-deep); font-weight: 750; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #d3b371; }

narrative.overview:
Hope-Alive pairs a field-guide sensibility with the clarity of a practical registration and staff tool. The visual mood is warm, grounded, editorial, welcoming, and practical: forest green anchors the interface, cream and paper create calm reading surfaces, and restrained earth accents make actions and important details easy to find.

Headlines bring a quiet editorial voice; forms and operational information remain direct and legible. Raised cards give the registration flow, participant details, and admin actions a consistent sense of place without competing with the content. Keep the existing Hope-Alive identity and camp artwork; avoid generic charity-template styling and excessive religious decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Forest-green anchors and warm, paper-like page surfaces.
Editorial serif headings paired with practical sans-serif controls and labels.
Confident rounded actions and softly lifted cards.
Clear, mobile-first registration and staff workflows.

rules.name: The Shared Ground Rule
rules.body: Forest anchors the system; gold and russet stay accents, while pale surfaces keep instructions and payment states easy to scan.

rules.name: The Editorial Interface Rule
rules.body: Use the display serif for prominent headings; keep actions, forms, and operational labels in the body sans-serif.

rules.name: The Shared Lift Rule
rules.body: Give card surfaces a visible shadow at rest; use a stronger lift only for hover or modal hierarchy, and respect reduced-motion preferences.

dos: Do use Warm Cream for editorial page areas and Soft Paper for forms and cards.
Do lift key cards with the shared forest-tinted shadows and retain visible borders.
Do keep Aged Gold and Burnished Russet as small action or emphasis accents.
Do keep payment and eligibility states understandable without relying on color alone.
Do retain the Hope-Alive identity and the existing camp artwork.
donts: Don't add unverified testimonials, impact numbers, or participant stories.
Don't replace the local identity with generic charity imagery.
Don't use decorative religious ornament as filler.
